The quotation is about funding for schools, nurseries, colleges, and special educational needs (SEND) — clearly education policy. Within I2, the passage is specifically about government funding allocations (educational finance) for inclusion, accessibility, and SEND provision.

I22 (Educational Finance • Financial Aid) fits well since the substance is specific budget allocations. However, the SEND/inclusion angle also touches on I24 (Education and Inequality), but the dominant framing is the financial allocations themselves. I28 (Government Policy) is the residual and should be avoided if a more specific code fits.

I22 captures the core mechanism — educational finance/funding — most precisely.
